headline: GTA 6 hacker Arion Kurtaj sentenced and released on licence
summary: Arion Kurtaj, who pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and other companies including Uber and Revolut, was sentenced and released on licence. He had leaked dozens of GTA VI videos in 2022, years before the game's release, and a judge warned him not to let it happen again.

claims.statement: Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games, among other companies, and was sentenced but released on licence.

sources.quote: 21-year-old Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to the Rockstar Games hack and others he carried out when he was a teenager.

Arion Kurtaj, who pleaded guilty last week to hacking Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games and other companies, including Uber and Revolut, was sentenced to seven years in prison but released on license
